text:
ANTIFRAUD::disable_injection
Description
This command disables Anti-Fraud injections for the current
transaction.
Note: requires a separate license for use.
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
disable_injection
Examples
when
HTTP_RESPONSE
{
if
{
[
HTTP
::
header
exists
"Antifraud-Disable-Injection"
]
}
{
ANTIFRAUD
::
disable_injection
log
local0.
"Injections disabled"
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
HTTP_RESPONSE
